scope: legible resistor values on retained native electrical sheets and registered .009 target-board bodies
promotion_rule: promote only a value printed unambiguously beside the same refdes, on the factory-identified target body, or in a clearly bracketed identical group; do not infer values from topology or color similarity

sources.observation: The D56 timing detail independently prints R47=20к, R59=33к, and R61=12к on the same retained RC/clear branches. The VT2 crop prints R62=2к, R63=1к, R64=5,1к, R65=430, R66=1к, and R67=2к; the owner R67 body is 4K7.

The factory-registered rightmost pale R66 body reads 1K0. The red R65 body left of VT2 reads К43 when the crop is rotated 270 degrees: K is the decimal marker in kilohms, so К43 is 430 ohms. Both agree with the exact .009 drawing.

An independent angle again shows 1K0 on R66 beside glass VD3. Rotating the R65 crop 270 degrees reveals the same К43 marking, despite a reflection across the body. This corroborates the fitted 430-ohm value but is not an isolated resistance measurement.
The D34 counter-load pulse shaper prints R33=620 ohms.
Native July crop directly reads К62 on the factory-position R33 body, independently of the May oblique view; this is a marking read, not an isolated resistance measurement.
Rotating the May oblique view 180 degrees independently reveals the К62 marking on the same R33-position body.

groups.name: sheet-2 D34 counter-load pulse shaper
groups.observation: Exact .009 sheet 2 prints R33=620 ohms; independent May and July target photos read К62 on its fitted body. Physical resistance and the hidden right-hand rail remain measurement holds.

groups.name: sheet-1 decode RC series resistor
groups.observation: R17 is printed 200 beside C99=160 in the D7/D9 decode path

groups.name: sheet-2 S3 switch pullup bank
groups.observation: the six identical R40-R45 pullups share the printed 15k group value below R45; the former 13k prose was a transcription error

groups.name: sheet-2 D56 timing network
groups.observation: the two AG3 timing resistors are printed R47=20k and R59=33k; the clear pullup is printed R61=12k, independently matching the exact .009 D56 tile

groups.name: sheet-2 video summing stage
groups.observation: the exact .009 video-output detail independently confirms R62=2k, R63=1k, R64=5.1k, R65=430, and R66=1k. May and July owner views directly corroborate fitted R65=К43 (430 ohms) and R66=1K0. The drawing also prints R67=2k, which conflicts with the directly readable fitted 4K7 target body

groups.name: .009 target video-clamp body
groups.observation: the factory drawing fixes the red vertical body between R66 and VD3 as R67; independent July and May owner views both directly read 4K7, superseding the 2k value printed on both .006 and exact .009 sheets for this fitted target part without assigning its unresolved far endpoint

groups.name: .009 D106 preset pull-up
groups.observation: the exact electrical sheet closes R78's D106 preset/UP pull-up role; the factory assembly drawing identifies the left member of the R78/R98 pair and the registered D106/D28-local owner photograph directly reads 10K

groups.name: sheet-2 beeper clamp
groups.observation: R90=2k and R91=1k are printed on the D58/VD4/VT1 AVDC branch; R48 is printed 8,2 Ом on the VT1 emitter-to-speaker output and the independently traced beeper boundary records the same 8.2R value
